phases.name: Authentication & Onboarding
phases.goal: Get the user in, connected, and seeing real data.

tasks.story: As a user, I can land on the Outround login page and see a clean sign-in screen with Google SSO and email/password options
As a user, I can sign in with Google and be redirected to the dashboard without additional setup steps
As a user, I can sign in with email and password
As a user, I can reset my password via email
As a user, my session persists across browser refreshes and tab closes
As a user, I can sign out from any page
As a new user, after first login I am taken through a 3-step onboarding: (1) connect Pipedrive, (2) connect Google Calendar, (3) choose my coach
As a new user, I can connect my Pipedrive account via OAuth — no manual API key entry
tasks.notes: Pipedrive OAuth 2.0. Scopes needed: deals:read, contacts:read, notes:read, activities:read

tasks.story: As a new user, I can connect my Google Calendar via OAuth
tasks.notes: Google Calendar API. Scopes needed: calendar.readonly

tasks.story: As a new user, I can choose my coach persona from a selection of 2-3 options
tasks.notes: Coach personas stored in DB. Each has: id, name, photo, personality description, coaching style, voice_id (ElevenLabs)

tasks.story: As a new user, I can skip onboarding steps and complete them later from settings
As a new user, once onboarding is complete I land on the dashboard with my real data already populated
tasks.notes: Trigger initial data sync on onboarding completion

tasks.story: As a returning user, I skip onboarding and go directly to the dashboard

phases.name: Dashboard & Meeting Intelligence
phases.goal: User opens the app and immediately sees value from their real data.

tasks.story: As a user, I can see my performance stats card — overall rating as dominant number plus sub-scores for: opening hook, objection handling, talk/listen ratio, pace, closing
tasks.notes: FIFA-style card. Sub-scores out of 100. Overall rating is weighted average. Dummy data acceptable at launch.

tasks.story: As a user, I can see trend arrows on each stat — up (green), down (red), flat (grey) — based on movement over last 5 rounds
tasks.notes: Requires session history. Arrows only shown after 2+ sessions.

tasks.story: As a user, I can see how many rounds I have completed in total and this week
As a user, I can see my current streak — consecutive days I have gone a round
As a user, I can see my coach name and avatar in the stats card area
As a user, I can see a list of upcoming meetings pulled from Google Calendar showing: title, prospect name, company, time, deal stage from Pipedrive
tasks.notes: Match calendar events to Pipedrive contacts by email. Show next 7 days.

tasks.story: As a user, meetings with a linked Pipedrive contact are visually distinct from generic calendar events
tasks.notes: Pipedrive-linked meetings show deal stage badge and prospect company logo if available

tasks.story: As a user, I can only interact with the next upcoming meeting — future meetings are visible but locked
tasks.notes: Locked meetings show a lock icon. Tooltip: 'Available when this is your next meeting.'

tasks.story: As a user, I can see at a glance whether I have already done an Outround for the next meeting
tasks.notes: Green checkmark or 'Ready' badge if round completed for this meeting

tasks.story: As a user, meetings that have passed are shown in a history section below upcoming meetings
As a user, the dashboard loads in under 2 seconds with real data
tasks.notes: Cache calendar and Pipedrive data. Refresh in background every 15 minutes.

tasks.story: As a user, I can see a notification if my Pipedrive or Calendar connection has an issue

phases.name: Meeting Preparation Page
phases.goal: User clicks their next meeting and gets everything they need to walk in ready.

tasks.story: As a user, I can click on the next meeting and see a full meeting preparation page
As a user, I can see the prospect's name, title, company, LinkedIn URL, and photo placeholder
tasks.notes: Pull from Pipedrive person record

tasks.story: As a user, I can see deal details from Pipedrive — deal name, stage, value, days in current stage
As a user, I can see all CRM notes from Pipedrive for this contact, displayed chronologically
tasks.notes: Pipedrive notes API. Show most recent 10, load more on scroll.

tasks.story: As a user, I can see a summary of the last call or meeting with this contact
tasks.notes: Pull from Pipedrive activities. If post-call analysis exists in Outround DB, use that.

tasks.story: As a user, I can see open tasks and next steps from Pipedrive for this deal
As a user, I can see AI-generated coaching notes — what to watch for in this meeting based on prospect history and my known weak spots
tasks.notes: Claude prompt: given prospect history + user weak spots, generate 3 coaching bullets

tasks.story: As a user, I can see a one-paragraph prospect intelligence summary generated by Claude from all available Pipedrive data
tasks.notes: Claude prompt: synthesise all CRM notes, activities, deal history into a single paragraph. Who is this person, how do they buy, what matters to them, what has been tried.

tasks.story: As a user, Outround assembles a dynamic AI persona from the Pipedrive contact data automatically when I open the meeting prep page
tasks.notes: Claude generates system prompt from CRM data. Stored in session config. Passed to ElevenLabs as conversation override.

tasks.story: As a user, I can see a summary of the assembled persona — communication style, known objections, resistance level
tasks.notes: Show user-facing summary only. Never expose raw system prompt.

tasks.story: As a user, if there is insufficient CRM data to build a persona, I am shown a message and offered a generic persona for the industry/role instead
tasks.notes: Fallback to generic persona templates stored in DB by role type

phases.name: The Outround Session
phases.goal: User goes a round against a digital twin of their actual prospect.

tasks.story: As a user, I can click Get Ready from the meeting prep page to begin an Outround session
As a user, I enter a warm-up voice conversation with my coach before the round begins
tasks.notes: Coach voice is distinct from prospect voice. Different ElevenLabs voice ID per coach persona.

tasks.story: As a user, my coach greets me by name and references my recent performance
tasks.notes: Claude generates coach warm-up script from: user name, last 3 session scores, identified weak spots, prospect profile summary

tasks.story: As a user, my coach gives me 2-3 specific things to focus on in this round
As a user, I can ask my coach a question before the round — and get an answer from CRM data
tasks.notes: Coach has access to full CRM context for this prospect during warm-up

tasks.story: As a user, I can skip the warm-up and go straight to the round
As a user, I see a 30-second brief card — prospect name, scenario, stakes — that disappears automatically
tasks.notes: Cannot be skipped. Auto-transitions after 30 seconds.

tasks.story: As a user, I am in a voice conversation with the AI persona built from my prospect's Pipedrive data
tasks.notes: ElevenLabs Conversational Agent with dynamic system prompt. Gladia for transcription. EU data residency required.

tasks.story: As a user, the AI persona can interrupt me, push back, object, disengage, and end the call
tasks.notes: System prompt instructs persona on resistance level, objection triggers, hang-up conditions

tasks.story: As a user, I can end the round at any time with an End Call button
As a user, if the AI persona hangs up, the interface detects this automatically and transitions to analysis
tasks.notes: Listen for ElevenLabs disconnection event. Show 'They hung up.' message for 2 seconds then auto-transition.

tasks.story: As a user, the round UI is minimal — waveform animation, duration timer, End Call button only
As a user, I see a loading screen with steps completing in sequence after the round ends
tasks.notes: Steps: Transcribing → Analysing → Generating coaching → Building report

tasks.story: As a user, a 3-sentence verdict appears within 2 seconds of the round ending before the full report loads
tasks.notes: Stream verdict first. Full analysis populates in background.

tasks.story: As a user, I see a full analysis page with: overall score, sub-scores, annotated transcript, coach commentary
tasks.notes: Left: annotated transcript. Right sidebar: score, sub-scores, metrics strip.

tasks.story: As a user, the transcript shows my lines at full weight and prospect lines muted, with coaching feedback inline
tasks.notes: Coaching feedback collapsed by default. Expandable on click per line.

tasks.story: As a user, I can see objective acoustic metrics: pace (WPM), talk/listen ratio, longest monologue, response latency, filler word count
tasks.notes: All metrics from Gladia transcript data. No emotion inference. Objective only.

tasks.story: As a user, I see a one-line brutal verdict from my coach — specific, direct, impossible to misread
tasks.notes: Claude prompt: generate a single sentence verdict in the voice of the chosen coach persona. Direct. No softening. Makes the user wince.

tasks.story: As a user, my stats card is updated immediately after the round
As a user, I can go again from the analysis page with one click

phases.name: Meeting Bot & Recording
phases.goal: Outround joins the real call, records it, admin done automatically after.

tasks.story: As a user, I can enable the meeting bot for a specific meeting from the meeting prep page — off by default
tasks.notes: Toggle with clear consent disclosure shown on enable

tasks.story: As a user, I see a clear disclosure when enabling the bot: all participants will see it in the call
tasks.notes: Legal requirement. Cannot be dismissed without reading.

tasks.story: As a user, the bot joins the call automatically at the scheduled start time when enabled
tasks.notes: Evaluate: Recall.ai or similar meeting bot infrastructure. Bot named 'Outround Notetaker'.

tasks.story: As a user, I can disable the bot for a specific meeting after enabling it, up until the call starts
As a user, I can set a default preference — bot on or off by default for all meetings with Pipedrive contacts
As a user, the bot records the full call and produces a word-level transcript with speaker diarisation
tasks.notes: Gladia for transcription. Speaker diarisation to separate user and prospect lines.

tasks.story: As a user, the transcript is available within 5 minutes of the call ending
As a user, raw audio is automatically deleted within 24 hours
tasks.notes: GDPR requirement. Scheduled deletion job. EU storage only.

tasks.story: As a user, raw transcript is automatically deleted within 30 days
tasks.notes: GDPR requirement. Scheduled deletion job.

tasks.story: As a user, I am notified by email when the post-call analysis is ready
As a user, I receive an email after every recorded call with: 3-paragraph summary, key moments, what landed and what didn't, recommended next steps
tasks.notes: Claude generates email from transcript. Clean, structured. Not a dashboard.

tasks.story: As a user, the email includes a practice vs real performance comparison if I did an Outround before this meeting
tasks.notes: Compare practice session scores to real call acoustic metrics

tasks.story: As a user, I can click through from the email to the full analysis in the app
tasks.notes: Unique link per call analysis. Auth-gated.

phases.name: CRM Enrichment
phases.goal: Pipedrive updates itself. The user never writes a note again.

tasks.story: As a user, after every recorded call, Outround automatically pushes structured metadata to Pipedrive
tasks.notes: Fields pushed: last call summary, objections raised, decision signals, competitor mentions, agreed next steps, deal stage recommendation

tasks.story: As a user, Outround creates a new activity in Pipedrive for the call with the summary attached
tasks.notes: Pipedrive activities API. Activity type: call. Duration from transcript.

tasks.story: As a user, I can review what was pushed to Pipedrive from the post-call analysis page before it is confirmed
tasks.notes: One-click approve or edit flow. Auto-approve after 24 hours if no action.

tasks.story: As a user, I can turn off automatic CRM push and switch to manual approval mode
As a user, the prospect's Outround profile is updated after every call — communication patterns, objections, what moves them
tasks.notes: Stored in Outround DB not Pipedrive. Used to build sharper personas for next session.

tasks.story: As a user, the enriched prospect profile is used to build a sharper persona for the next Outround session
tasks.notes: Persona assembly pulls from both Pipedrive data and Outround enrichment layer

tasks.story: As a user, I can see the enriched prospect profile on the meeting prep page — gets more detailed with every call
As a user, my performance profile is updated after every real call — not just practice rounds
tasks.notes: Acoustic metrics from real calls feed into user profile alongside practice session data

tasks.story: As a user, patterns identified across multiple real calls are surfaced in my stats card and coaching notes
tasks.notes: Requires minimum 3 real calls to surface patterns

phases.name: Coach Agent
phases.goal: The coach relationship forms. User comes back even without an upcoming meeting.

tasks.story: As a new user, I choose my coach from 2-3 personas during onboarding — name, photo, personality, coaching style
tasks.notes: Coach personas in DB. Each has: id, name, photo, personality, coaching_style, voice_id, system_prompt_template

tasks.story: As a user, I can change my coach from settings — with confirmation that history carries over
As a user, if I haven't done a round in 5+ days, my coach sends a Slack or email nudge — personal not generic
tasks.notes: Scheduled job checks last activity. Claude generates personalised nudge in coach voice.

tasks.story: As a user, the nudge references something specific — upcoming meeting, weak spot, streak milestone
As a user, I can respond to the nudge and go straight into a round without opening the app
tasks.notes: Slack interactive button. Deep link to session start.

phases.name: Team & Manager Features
phases.goal: Individual Pro becomes trojan horse into team contracts.

tasks.story: As a manager, I can see all reps in a single dashboard — rating, trend, rounds this week, last active
As a manager, I can see team-wide weak spots — which skills are declining across the team
As a manager, I can see which reps have done an Outround before their meetings this week
As a manager, I can click into any rep's profile and see their full stats card and session history
As an admin, I can invite team members by email
As an admin, I can remove team members
As an admin, I can see billing and usage across the team

phases.name: Settings & Profile
phases.goal: User controls their experience and can manage their account.

tasks.story: As a user, I can connect and disconnect Pipedrive from settings
As a user, I can connect and disconnect Google Calendar from settings
As a user, I can connect Slack from settings for ambient notifications
As a user, I can see the status of each integration — connected, disconnected, error
As a user, I can export all my data
tasks.notes: GDPR right to portability

tasks.story: As a user, I can delete my account and all associated data
tasks.notes: GDPR right to erasure. Cascade delete all user data including prospect profiles.

tasks.story: As a user, I can request deletion of a specific prospect's data
tasks.notes: GDPR Article 17. Must also delete from Pipedrive custom fields on request.

phases.name: Internal Admin Dashboard
phases.goal: Founder visibility into every session and user without a code deploy.

tasks.story: As an admin, I can see every session — who ran it, when, duration, score
As an admin, I can see every user — signup date, last active, plan, sessions completed
As an admin, I can view the raw transcript and grading output for any session
As an admin, I can view and edit system prompts and grading prompts without a code deploy
tasks.notes: Config stored in DB not code. Admin UI for editing.

tasks.story: As an admin, I can see all errors and failed sessions

elevenlabs_api.notes: Use EU residency endpoint for all European users. Conversational Agents for voice sessions.

gladia_api.notes: GDPR compliant. EU hosted. Use for all transcription and acoustic metrics.

claude_api.notes: Used for: briefing generation, persona assembly, grading, coaching commentary, CRM enrichment extraction

slack_api.notes: Used for ambient delivery — pre-meeting briefings, post-call summaries, coach nudges

meeting_bot_api.notes: Evaluate Recall.ai for meeting bot infrastructure. Handles Zoom, Google Meet, Teams. EU data options available.
